title: A red main whose only failed job never ran gets a --job repro that passes, so red-pipeline files nothing
goal: red-pipeline and ql_deliver.pipeline_failure name a job in the repro (--job) only when that job ran and failed; otherwise the repro is plain --status, so a pipeline red by status with a job failed without running (ci_quota_exceeded, runner_system_failure) is still filed; a test plants it with an older pipeline where the same job passed. From the SP-z7a5c76b review.
